Item 4.02. Non-Reliance on Previously Issued Financial Statements or a Related Audit Report or Completed Interim Review.

On March 14, 2024, the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors of Example Corp (the "Company") concluded, after consultation with the Company's independent registered public accounting firm, PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP, that the Company's previously issued audited consolidated financial statements for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022, as included in the Company's Annual Report on Form 10-K filed on February 28, 2023, and the related audit report of PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP, should no longer be relied upon due to errors identified in the Company's revenue recognition methodology for certain multi-element arrangements.

The Company has determined that the errors resulted in an overstatement of revenue for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022 of approximately $47 million, representing approximately 3.2% of total reported revenues for that period. The Audit Committee has directed the Company's management to restate the affected financial statements.

The Company anticipates filing an amended Annual Report on Form 10-K/A with restated financial statements as soon as practicable. The Company's management and Audit Committee have discussed the matters disclosed in this Item 4.02 with PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP.

Investors and financial statement users should not rely on the financial statements and related audit report identified above until the restatement is completed and the amended filing is made.
